title: Fifth Third Bancorp 8-K Filing — 2026-04-24
summary: Fifth Third Bancorp filed a Form 8-K reporting results from its April 21, 2026 Annual Meeting of Shareholders, where all 16 board director nominees were elected, Deloitte & Touche LLP was ratified as external auditor for 2026, and executive compensation was approved by advisory vote.
key_points: All 16 board director nominees elected to serve until the 2027 Annual Meeting with votes-for ranging from approximately 701M to 734M.
Deloitte & Touche LLP ratified as independent external auditor for 2026 with 783.8M votes for, 47M against, and 613K abstain; no broker non-votes.
Executive compensation advisory vote passed with 699.2M votes for, 39.9M against, 2.1M abstain, and 90.2M broker non-votes.
No departures of directors or officers reported under Item 5.02 (section not populated).
